#!/usr/bin/python
import os
import sys
import time

base = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
results_path = os.path.join(base, "results.tsv")

try:
    job_count = int(sys.argv[1])
except (IndexError, ValueError):
    sys.stderr.write("usage: %s JOB_COUNT\n" % sys.argv[0])
    sys.exit(2)

if job_count < 0:
    sys.stderr.write("JOB_COUNT must be non-negative\n")
    sys.exit(2)

children = {}
for number in range(job_count):
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        time.sleep(0.1)
        os._exit((number % 2) * 3)
    children[pid] = number

needs_header = not os.path.exists(results_path) or os.path.getsize(results_path) == 0
results = open(results_path, "a")
if needs_header:
    results.write("run\tjob\texit_status\n")
    results.flush()

run_id = str(os.getpid())
while children:
    pid, wait_status = os.wait()
    number = children.pop(pid)
    if os.WIFEXITED(wait_status):
        exit_status = os.WEXITSTATUS(wait_status)
    elif os.WIFSIGNALED(wait_status):
        exit_status = 128 + os.WTERMSIG(wait_status)
    else:
        continue
    results.write("%s\t%d\t%d\n" % (run_id, number, exit_status))
    results.flush()

results.close()
